# LTReee

> LTReee is a free, fast, dark-themed link-in-bio builder for developers, creators and indie hackers. One short link (ltreee.app/username) holds your links, projects, contact info, private links and embeddable widgets.

## Features
- Link-in-bio page at ltreee.app/username with optional email/phone contact chips
- Developer Arena: showcase projects with covers, demo and repository links, and visit analytics
- Link-in-bio leaderboard: community upvote/downvote ranking of developer projects (sign-in required, no self-voting)
- Embeddable iframe widget: vertical, horizontal, grid and icon layouts; dark, light or transparent themes
- Private links vault, plus embed view and click analytics

## Pages
- [Home](https://ltreee.app/): create a free link-in-bio page
- [Leaderboard](https://ltreee.app/leaderboard): top developer projects ranked by votes
- [Link in bio guide](https://ltreee.app/link-in-bio)
- [Free link in bio](https://ltreee.app/free-link-in-bio)
- [Instagram bio link](https://ltreee.app/instagram-bio-link)
- [Linktree alternative](https://ltreee.app/linktree-alternative)
- [For developers](https://ltreee.app/developers)
- [Example profile](https://ltreee.app/examples)
